export PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH ELAN_TOOLCHAIN=v4.35.0-local && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='LatticeProofs/Pilot.lean'
s=open(p).read()
oldE = """  have hι : ζ * ζ⁻¹ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ h0
  refine triSub_even hζ.pow_eq_one ?_ ?_ hp
  · sorry
  · sorry

/-- E + VO + VS"""
newE = """  have hsq : ζ ^ 2 - 1 ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    exact one_add_sq_ne_zero hm3 hζ (by linear_combination h + h2K)
  refine triSub_even hζ.pow_eq_one ?_ ?_ hp
  · have hlam : ∑ d ∈ triSEOffsets, ζ ^ (-(d.1 - d.2)) * ζ ^ (-d.2) = 1 := by
      simp [triSEOffsets]
      field_simp
      linear_combination (ζ ^ 2 + ζ + 1) * h2K
    rw [hlam]
    exact one_ne_zero
  · have hμ : (∑ d ∈ triSEOffsets, ζ ^ (-(d.1 - d.2)) * ζ ^ (-d.2) *
        ((-(d.1 - d.2) : ℤ) : AlgebraicClosure (ZMod 2))) * ζ = ζ ^ 2 - 1 := by
      simp [triSEOffsets]
      field_simp
      ring
    intro h
    rw [h, zero_mul] at hμ
    exact hsq hμ.symm

/-- E + VO + VS"""
assert oldE in s
s=s.replace(oldE,newE)
oldV = """  have hι : ζ * ζ⁻¹ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ h0
  refine triSub_even hζ.pow_eq_one ?_ ?_ hp
  · sorry
  · sorry"""
newV = """  have hsq : (1 + ζ ^ 2) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero 2 (one_add_sq_ne_zero hm3 hζ)
  refine triSub_even hζ.pow_eq_one ?_ ?_ hp
  · have hlam : (∑ d ∈ triSEVOVSOffsets, ζ ^ (-(d.1 - d.2)) * ζ ^ (-d.2)) * ζ ^ 2 =
        (1 + ζ ^ 2) ^ 2 := by
      simp [triSEVOVSOffsets]
      field_simp
      linear_combination (2 * ζ ^ 3 + 2 * ζ) * h2K
    intro h
    rw [h, zero_mul] at hlam
    exact hsq hlam.symm
  · have hμ : (∑ d ∈ triSEVOVSOffsets, ζ ^ (-(d.1 - d.2)) * ζ ^ (-d.2) *
        ((-(d.1 - d.2) : ℤ) : AlgebraicClosure (ZMod 2))) * ζ ^ 2 = (1 + ζ ^ 2) ^ 2 := by
      simp [triSEVOVSOffsets]
      field_simp
      linear_combination (-1 - ζ - ζ ^ 2 + ζ ^ 3) * h2K
    intro h
    rw [h, zero_mul] at hμ
    exact hsq hμ.symm"""
assert oldV in s
s=s.replace(oldV,newV)
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
lake env lean LatticeProofs/Pilot.lean 2>&1 | head -60
